title: Named Entity Recognition in Twitter: A Dataset and Analysis on Short-Term Temporal Shifts

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing Named Entity Recognition (NER) model performance (micro/macro F1 scores) when trained on data from an older time period (2019-2020) and tested on data from a newer, unseen time period (2020-2021) to measure short-term performance degradation.

Retrieving context-diverse tweets for specific target entities and analyzing self-labeled predictions to measure the model's tendency to memorize entities and output the same prediction irrespective of the surrounding textual context.
